g.text: Optimal variable-I_sp power-limited rendezvous, Earth escape to Mars capture (coplanar circular orbits, planetary spirals excluded);
J = ∫a²dt by direct optimisation; payload fraction = (1 − √(J/2ηα))², η = 0.6. Shaded bands are indicative.
